runtime: Real local workerd/Miniflare, D1 and R2 with test-only request-context-safe R2 hold barriers

behavior.budgetLimitation: Weighted admission bounds buffered writes; it is not a bound on total isolate heap usage.

regressionChecks: Held A write permits unrelated new B GET 200/null and same A GET matching prior committed revision/hash
B write and subsequent exact GET complete before A write is released
Overlapping same-account PUT gets retryable 503/save_busy and stale revision after release remains 409/save_conflict
Eight held independent writes admit no ninth writer but keep save GET and preferences available
Injected R2 failure releases both account slot and budget; another and the failed account write successfully
Unknown request length reserves full weighted allowance while independent GET stays available; completion releases allowance
preserved: D1 revision CAS and operation-id idempotency
Exact R2 key, size, hash and user validation
scope: Only owned backend module and test file edited in official stage. No production account data writes, migration changes, canonical-source edits or deployment.
testHarnessRepairs: Initial promise gate was replaced by boolean state and per-request timers to respect workerd request contexts.
Valid HTTP test bodies now carry their actual Content-Length; intentionally oversized streams omit the header so the body limit is tested without Miniflare early-close transport termination.
